# The endpoint is at rightmost (col 39-41). Clicking (50,30) had no effect.
# Maybe the endpoint position determines which column can be clicked.
# Let me move endpoint to center and try clicking (50,30).

# First check current endpoint position
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 8:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"Endpoint at col {min_c}")
        break

# Move LEFT to center position (should be around col 31)
# From col 39, need to move LEFT twice to get to col 31
result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT'])

for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 8:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"Endpoint now at col {min_c}")
        break

# Now try clicking (50,30) which is center column
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 50, 'col': 30}])
print(f"Click (50,30): board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check checkerboard

for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 9 and n['color'] in ('W', 'N', 'g', 'G'):
        boundary = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"  {n['color']}: center=({min_r+1},{min_c+1})")
